instruction: Design the main screen (a single page) for an in-game friends and party system. Include a player profile header, searchable friends list with avatars and online states, pending requests, a selected-friend detail panel, and clear Add Friend, Invite to Game, and Battle actions. Show at least one active party or invitation state. Put strong emphasis on social clarity, status legibility, warm personality, coherent component design, and polished game-interface finish.
